parent_objective: matched baseline natural history-value surface evaluation

public_gates: designed natural history-value surface eval for trained L0/L2/L3 checkpoints
kept M526 natural event rows as public diagnostic surfaces
no checkpoint promoted from route metrics alone
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune checkpoint choice on the same natural diagnostic rows and call it unbiased
do not mix projected and natural rows in one claim
do not add privileged actor inputs
hypothesis: A natural-surface evaluation can be designed for the matched short-train checkpoints so the project measures whether trained L2/L3 policies preserve the M524/M526 history-value event advantage rather than only improving smoke returns.
success_criteria: define which natural surfaces and metrics to evaluate
define how to map trained L0/L2/L3 checkpoints into the evaluation harness
define public diagnostic versus future holdout usage
select the next executable natural-surface eval milestone
failure_criteria: design uses projected rows as natural evidence
design tunes checkpoint selection from diagnostic rows before declaring evidence

commands.name: natural_surface_eval_design
commands.command: Designed the frozen source-surface evaluator semantics for matched L0/L2/L3 natural history-value evaluation after M533 repeat-seed route success.

decision_rule: M534 is a design gate. It should not run the natural-surface evaluation until the trained-checkpoint mapping and evidence boundaries are explicit.
scoreboard_reason: M534 designs a frozen M399 source-surface evaluator so trained L0 L2 and L3 checkpoints can be compared on matched natural states without mixing projected surfaces or claiming private holdout evidence.
